title: Arithmetic Shift Unit
statement: Design an arithmetic right shift unit that shifts a signed 16-bit input right by a 4-bit shift amount while preserving the sign bit. The vacant MSBs should be filled with the original sign. This block is used in signed division and normalization operations.
module_signature: module arithmetic_shift_unit(input signed [15:0] a, input [3:0] shamt, output [15:0] y);
behavior: y is a shifted right version of a with sign extension.
If shamt is 0, y equals a.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential or clocked behavior.
hint: Shift the vector and fill upper bits with the sign bit.
